guides.remove-background-wedding-portrai: Remove a Wedding Photo Background Cleanly
Get a clean cut-out from a wedding portrait: what makes hair and veil edges hard, when to use a transparent PNG, and how to check the result.
Wedding Portrait Background Removal Guide
Cut-outs succeed or fail at the edges. Hair, veils, lace and translucent fabric are where an automatic mask needs the most attention.
Output
PNG with alpha for transparency; JPG for a flat colour
Edges
Check hair, veil, bouquet stems and chair gaps
Lighting
A subject lit differently from the new background looks pasted on
Resolution
Keep the original pixel dimensions for print use

Start with the sharpest original you have — a slightly soft edge is much harder to mask than fine detail. After removal, zoom to 100% and inspect the outline against both a light and a dark background; halos that disappear on white show up immediately on black. A tiny feather on the mask usually looks more natural than a hard pixel edge.

Transparent PNG is the safest interchange format for most design tools and print labs, though some online print portals still prefer a flattened JPEG on a white background. If the cut-out is for a save-the-date or invitation that will be professionally printed, ask the printer whether they accept alpha channels or require a PDF with a clipping path. For web use, WebP with alpha is smaller but less universally supported.

Do not use a cut-out at a larger size than the source supported, and do not place a warm indoor portrait onto a cool outdoor background without adjusting the colour temperature. Watch for leftover shadow trapped between the arm and the body, and for a grey fringe if the original background was dark. Save the layered version so the mask can be refined later.
Which file format keeps transparency?
PNG with an alpha channel is the most widely accepted. WebP also supports transparency but check the receiving tool first.
Why does the hair look jagged?
Fine strands are smaller than the mask's detail threshold. Use the highest-resolution original and a slightly feathered edge.
Can I print a transparent PNG?
Many labs prefer a flattened image. Ask for their spec, and export a white or coloured background version if alpha is unsupported.
